{{Quote|Take this datadisc to Banyon Craddok, he's an investigator I've helped a time or two in the past. He'll know what to do with it. You may want to keep an eye out for Black Sun. I think they may be involved in this.|Noren Krast|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Banyon Craddok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian Security Force]] investigator who on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|This will put things in a different light. You tell Krast not to worry. It'll all be taken care of.|Banyon Craddok|<ref name="AED" />}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Noren Krast]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with delivering a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] to Banyon Craddok.<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BanynCraddokFemale.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Female depiction of Banyon Craddok, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Banyon Craddok was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />

While the quest dialogue identified this character's first name as "Banyon," examining the character itself revealed the full name to be '''Banyn Craddok'''. This article assumes "Banyon" to be the correct first name.<ref name="AED" />
